answer: One concrete defense is bonded attestation history. Each agent locks a refundable stake and must earn peer signatures across many epochs; picture the ledger as an atlas mapping every identity to its real track record. A fresh sybil is a walnut with nothing inside: no bond, no history, so honest peers decline to attest it. Promotion from a provisional violet tier to full trust demands slow, costly, continuous participation that cheap cloning simply cannot shortcut.
